notes.title: Hell Empire: Sinners Flow will be available soon!
notes.notes:
Soon you will fight for the post of the Prince of Darkness right hand! To do so, your control hell area must be the most successful. So, distribute sinners to the boilers as quickly as possible, otherwise these evil souls will leave you, and the Dark Lord will not pat you on the back for it. Using resources received from each boiler you can open a new circle of hell!
Please subscribe and add the game to your wishlist!
Joystick Knights Team.
